title: d_r alongside d_s, the pitcher-hand-2 miss-row backoff removed, k400 x self attribution, and the k grid extended — all post-hoc transforms of stored predictions, no training

arms.C0: k=400 x league  (= exp_024 arm B = the d of candidate J).  CONTROL.
arms.C1: C0 with L forced to 0 on pitcher_hand==2 CELL-MISS rows only; every hit row and every pitcher-hand-1 row is bit-identical to C0
arms.C2: k=400 x self (hard backoff): d = d_s(400) + (cell miss)*L
arms.C5: C0 + d_r at k=400 x league, betas fitted JOINTLY (2x2, no intercept)
arms.C6: as C5 but d_r at k=65
arms.C7: C1 + d_r at k=400 x league (TWO variables vs C0 — not attributable)

changed_vs_exp_025: NEW deviation axis d_r (marginal reverse rate) with its own personal and league tables, built by devgen.py
NEW two-term joint beta fit (2x2 normal equations, no intercept)
C1 removes the league backoff ONLY on pitcher-hand-2 CELL-MISS rows; exp_025's B_ph1only removed it on ALL pitcher-hand-2 rows
k grid extended upward to 1600 and 3200
k=400 x self added as the attribution control for the shrink target
no training, no new base vectors — identical reuse to exp_025
unchanged_vs_exp_025: base vectors and their sha256, exp_004 F-mask, clip 1e-6, supply blocks 2022+2023, closed-form no-intercept slope for one-term arms, backoff.py / dev_k.py / offset.py / features_platoon.py / labels.py / exp016_ref.py byte-identical (sha asserted)

reproduction_gate.source: exp_024/metrics.json per_seed[seed].B_candidate.brier — READ from the record, not transcribed
reproduction_gate.on_fail: abort — the reused vectors or the inherited code are not exp_024's and nothing downstream is readable

devgen_equivalence_check.what: devgen at key='succ' vs the byte-preserved dev_k.py / backoff.py

C1_scope_check.rule: L := 0 where pitcher_hand == 2 AND the personal cell is EMPTY
C1_scope_check.differs_from_exp025_B_ph1only: exp_025 zeroed L on ALL pitcher-hand-2 rows, hit rows included; this zeroes only the miss rows

label_isolation_check.note: no model is fitted here, so the design matrix is exp_024's; check (b) below is the operative one for this experiment

asof_independent_recheck.method: row_id -> season re-read from train.csv in a SECOND pass; the max season of the CONTRIBUTING ROW IDS is looked up in that independent map, not in the frame the tables were built from
asof_independent_recheck.note: the reverse tables use the IDENTICAL row masks as the success tables (asserted below), so one check covers both numerators

adoption.rule: 3 seeds agree in sign AND |mean delta| >= 3 x C0 seed std.  Not relaxed.  The paired-delta std is reported as a reference number only and is not part of the rule.

selection.discipline: everything CHOSEN is chosen on the supply blocks; fold_2024 is read afterwards and is reported as the oracle counterfactual only
selection.primary_surface: block Brier at the block-fitted beta (exp_023's registered surface)
selection.secondary_surface: cross-block: fit 2022 -> score 2023 and the reverse, pooled

conversion.sensitivity: brier 1e-6 = score 0.4003; a 6-decimal Brier carries +-0.2002 in the converted number
conversion.caveat: local measurement is at iter 650 (<=2023 training); the deployed build is iter 7700 (<=2024).

leak_boundary.tables: a season-s row reads tables built on seasons <= s-1 only, for BOTH numerators; asserted at runtime inside backoff.py / dev_k.py / devgen.py and again here by an independent second read of train.csv
leak_boundary.recovered_labels: `rev` = is_rev_only + is_both is a RECOVERED label (row t+1).  It is used only as the numerator of a frozen table, never as a row-level input; group-constancy of every deviation inside (season, pitcher, batter_hand, pitcher_hand) is asserted, which a row-level leak would break
leak_boundary.beta_fit: supply blocks 2022+2023 of the same seed, on that arm's own columns; no arm's beta ever sees 2024
leak_boundary.arm_choice: arms fixed by config.yaml before any 2024 number is read; k and the d_r shrink constant are selected on the blocks; C1 and C2 are pre-registered contrasts
leak_boundary.design_matrix: unchanged — no deviation is ever a model feature, and no training happens in this experiment
leak_boundary.missing: no sentinel fill anywhere; L=0 and d=0 mean 'apply no correction', the behaviour without the module
